unitTitle: Past Simple - A/An/The - Will - Linking Words
scanNote:
GRAMMAR 46-BET. Unit 10 — zamonlar, bog'lovchilar va artikllar.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 11-mashq (6-10-bandlar), 12-mashq (19 bo'shliq), 13-mashq (19 bo'shliq), 14-mashq (8 bog'lovchi), 15-mashq (17 artikl) — jami 60 dan ortiq javob.

⚠ 14-MAShQ — BESh BOG'LOVChINING VAZIFASI:
  BECAUSE — sabab       ('went to the doctor BECAUSE she was ill')
  AND     — qo'shish    ('finished work AND went home')
  BUT     — qarama-qarshilik ('I love it BUT my sister doesn't')
  WHEN    — vaqt nuqtasi ('WHEN I was nine')
  UNTIL   — shu paytgacha ('didn't go UNTIL my mother came home')
  ⚠ 5 va 7-bandni solishtiring: 'UNTIL my mother came' = onam kelgunicha (kutish); 'WHEN I got home' = uyga yetgach (o'sha payt).

⚠ 15-MAShQ — ARTIKL QO'YILMAYDIGAN JOYLAR:
  • shahar va mamlakat nomlari: Athens, Greece, America, New York
  • odam ismlari: Jerry
  • ovqat nomlari: dinner
  ⚠ LEKIN ISTISNOLAR BOR:
  • OILA nomi ko'plikda → THE Browns
  • yagona yodgorlik/bino → THE Statue of Liberty
  ⚠ 8-bandda ikkalasi bir gapda: 'THE Statue of Liberty is in — New York'.

⚠ 15-MAShQ — A yoki THE:
  5-band: 'a picnic in THE park' — piknik BIRINCHI marta aytilyapti (a), park esa ma'lum (the).
  7-band: 'an awful film at THE cinema' — xuddi shu mantiq.
  6-band: '— dinner' (ovqat nomi, artiklsiz) va 'a cake' (bitta tort).

⚠ FAKT TEKShIRILDI: 10-band 'Vivaldi was a famous composer and violinist' — Antonio Vivaldi haqiqatan ham italiyalik bastakor VA skripkachi bo'lgan. To'g'ri.

⚠ 13-MAShQ 6-BAND — TUZOQ: 'They ......... (go) to the park EVERY SATURDAY LAST SPRING.' 'Every Saturday' hozirgi zamonni eslatadi, lekin 'last spring' o'tgan zamonni bildiradi. To'g'ri javob — WENT (o'tmishdagi odat).

sections.title: Uch zamonni farqlash
sections.titleUz: Present simple / present continuous / past simple

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous or past simple. (continued from page 45)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying. (45-betdan davomi)
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 45-betdagi 11-mashqning DAVOMI (6-10-bandlar).

UCH ZAMON BELGILARI:
  PRESENT SIMPLE     → every evening, usually, often
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS → at the moment, now, right now
  PAST SIMPLE        → yesterday, last week, ... ago

items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + cooking.

'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
make → MADE (noto'g'ri fe'l).

'last week' → PAST SIMPLE.
have → HAD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'toothache' = tish og'rig'i — artikl YO'Q (kasallik nomi).

'every evening' → PRESENT SIMPLE (takrorlanadigan odat).
'Bill' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → play + S = PLAYS.

items.textEn: 10  Julie ............ (read) a magazine at the moment.
items.whyUz:
'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Julie' BIRLIK → IS + reading.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous, or past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQDA DIALOGLAR BOR — BIR SUHBATDA IKKI ZAMON
HAM BO'LISHI MUMKIN.

UCH ZAMONNING SO'ROQ SHAKLLARI:

  PRESENT SIMPLE:
     DO / DOES + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
        Does your brother like football?

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
     AM / IS / ARE + ega + fe'l-ING?
        Are you doing ...?  Is he writing ...?

  PAST SIMPLE:
     DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
        Did you go ...?  Did Bob work ...?

DIQQAT — 5 va 6-BANDLARDA IKKI ZAMON BIRGA:
  'She IS PLAYING computer games.' (hozir, ayni damda)
  'She usually PLAYS computer games.' (odat)
  Bitta suhbatda ikkalasi ham to'g'ri —
  chunki ular BOSHQA-BOSHQA narsani aytadi.

items.whyUz:
Yoqtirish — DOIMIY holat → PRESENT SIMPLE.
'your brother' 3-shaxs birlik → DOES + ASOSIY shakl.
DIQQAT: 'Does he likes' XATO — 'does' bor bo'lsa -S YO'Q.

PRESENT SIMPLE, 'he' → like + S = LIKES.
Bu yerda 'does' YO'Q → -S QO'ShILADI.

Javobdagi 'at the moment' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'you' → ARE + you + DOING.

items.textEn: 2  B: We ............ (watch) TV at the moment.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'We' → ARE + watching.

'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
DID + you + GO (asosiy shakl).
'go swimming' — predlogsiz, -ing shakli bilan.

PAST SIMPLE. 'it' BIRLIK → WAS.
'too cold' = juda sovuq.

PAST SIMPLE. go → WENT.
'so' = shuning uchun (natijani bog'laydi).

'last year' → PAST SIMPLE.
DID + Bob + WORK.

items.textEn: 4  B: He ............ (work) at a private school.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE, 'did' YO'Q → WORKED.
'a private school' = xususiy maktab.

PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
IS + she + DOING.

PRESENT CONTINUOUS (savolga mos).
'She' → IS + playing.

items.textEn: 5  B: She usually ............ (play) computer games in her free time.
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'She' → play + S = PLAYS.
DIQQAT: oldingi band bilan solishtiring —
'is playing' (hozir) ↔ 'plays' (odatda).

PAST SIMPLE (harakat TUGAGAN).
DID + you + BUY ('bought' EMAS).

PAST SIMPLE. buy → BOUGHT.
'Harrods' — Londondagi mashhur univermag.

items.textEn: 6  B: I always ............ (buy) my clothes there.
items.whyUz:
'always' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'I' → BUY (-S YO'Q, faqat he/she/it uchun).
DIQQAT: bir suhbatda 'bought' (o'sha safar) va
'buy' (odatda) — ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.

items.hintUz: Vaqt belgisi yo'q — ayni damdagi holat
items.whyUz:
Vaqt belgisi YO'Q → suhbat AYNI DAMDA sodir bo'layotgan
harakat haqida → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
IS + he + WRITING.
ESLATMA: vaqt belgisi bo'lmagani uchun past simple
('Did he write ...? — Yes, he did. He wrote ...')
ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri bo'lardi.

Savol 'Is he ...?' → javob 'Yes, he IS.'
Qisqa javobda savoldagi yordamchi fe'l takrorlanadi.

items.textEn: 7  B: He ............ (write) a letter to his father.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'He' → IS + writing.
'write TO somebody' — predlog TO.

Javobdagi 'two hours ago' → PAST SIMPLE.
DID + you + FINISH.

items.textEn: 8  B: I ............ (finish) it two hours ago.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. finish → FINISHED.
'two hours ago' — 'ago' gap oxirida.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous or past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'N BESH BAND — UCHALA ZAMON ARALASH.

BIR NECHTA ALDAMCHI BAND BOR:

  2-BAND — 'READ' fe'li:
     read → READ  (yozilishi BIR XIL!)
     Lekin O'QILISHI boshqacha:
        hozirgi: /riːd/ ('riid')
        o'tgan:  /red/  ('red')

  6-BAND — 'every Saturday LAST SPRING':
     'every Saturday' hozirgi zamonga o'xshaydi,
     lekin 'LAST spring' bor → PAST SIMPLE.
     Ma'nosi: o'tgan bahorda har shanba borishardi
     (endi bormaydi).

  5 va 12-BANDLAR — INKOR shakllari:
     '(not/do)'  → didn't   (qisqa javobda)
     '(not/be)'  → weren't  ('to be' — 'didn't' KERAK EMAS)

items.textEn: 1  Jim ............ (have) his breakfast at the moment.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Jim' BIRLIK → IS + having.
DIQQAT: 'have breakfast' — HARAKAT ma'nosida,
shuning uchun -ing mumkin.
('have' = ega bo'lmoq ma'nosida -ing OLMAYDI.)

'yesterday' → PAST SIMPLE.
read → READ — YOZILIShI BIR XIL, lekin
O'QILIShI boshqacha:
  hozirgi: /riːd/  ('riid')
  o'tgan:  /red/   ('red')
Bu — ingliz tilidagi eng g'alati noto'g'ri fe'l.

PAST SIMPLE.
DID + you + WATCH.

'right now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'My sister' BIRLIK → IS + playing.

PAST SIMPLE.
DID + you + STAY.

'(not/do)' → DIDN'T.
Qisqa javobda faqat 'didn't' — asosiy fe'l YO'Q.
'No, I didn't.'

items.textEn: 5  B: I ............ (go) to my friend's house.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. go → WENT.
"my friend'S house" — egalik apostrofi.

items.textEn: 6  They ............ (go) to the park every Saturday last spring.
items.whyUz:
'LAST spring' → PAST SIMPLE.
'every Saturday' hozirgi zamonga o'xshaydi, lekin
u O'TMISHDAGI odat haqida — endi takrorlanmaydi.
go → WENT.
Bu — mashqning eng aldamchi bandi.

items.textEn: 7  Sara and Tim ............ (look) for a flat at the moment.
items.whyUz:
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'Sara and Tim' KO'PLIK → ARE + looking.
'look FOR' = qidirmoq;  'a flat' = kvartira.

items.textEn: 8  Wendy ............ (wake) up at seven every morning.
items.whyUz:
'every morning' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'Wendy' BIRLIK → wake + S = WAKES.
'wake up' = uyg'onmoq.
'AT seven' — soat bilan AT.

items.textEn: 9  A: Where ............ (she/go) for her holidays last year?
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE.
DID + she + GO.

PAST SIMPLE. go → WENT.
'go TO Spain' — predlog TO.

items.textEn: 10  Laura ............ (become) a dentist two years ago.
items.whyUz:
'two years ago' → PAST SIMPLE.
become → BECAME.
'a dentist' = tish shifokori.

items.textEn: 11  The Wilsons usually ............ (go) out for dinner on Tuesdays.
items.whyUz:
'usually' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'The Wilsons' KO'PLIK → GO (-S YO'Q).
'The Wilsons' = Uilsonlar oilasi (42-betdagi qoida).
'ON Tuesdays' — takrorlanadigan kunlar → ko'plik + ON.

PAST SIMPLE.
DID + you + CALL.

'(not/be)' → 'to be' fe'lining INKORI.
'they' KO'PLIK, o'tgan zamon → WEREN'T.
DIQQAT: 'to be' bilan 'didn't' KERAK EMAS —
'they didn't be' XATO.

items.textEn: 13  He often ............ (play) football in his free time.
items.whyUz:
'often' → PRESENT SIMPLE (odat).
'He' → play + S = PLAYS.

items.textEn: 14  My mother ............ (return) late from work yesterday.
items.whyUz:
PAST SIMPLE. return → RETURNED.
'return FROM work' = ishdan qaytmoq.
'late' = kech.

'right now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS.
'I' → AM + doing.
'do homework' — 'make' EMAS, DO.

exercises.explanationUz:
BESH BOG'LOVCHI (43-betdagi nazariyadan):

  AND     — qo'shimcha ma'lumot
  BUT     — QARAMA-QARShILIK
  BECAUSE — SABAB
  WHEN    — VAQT (o'sha paytda)
  UNTIL   — ...GACHA (harakatning oxiri)

USUL — IKKINCHI QISMGA QARANG:

  Ikkinchi qism SABABNI aytadimi?
     → BECAUSE
  Ikkinchi qism birinchisiga QARAMA-QARShImi?
     → BUT
  Ikkinchi qism QAChON bo'lganini aytadimi?
     → WHEN
  Birinchi harakat QAChONGACHA davom etdimi?
     → UNTIL
  Shunchaki QO'ShIMCHA ma'lumotmi?
     → AND

items.textEn: 1  Sally went to the doctor because / and she was ill.
items.whyUz:
'she was ill' — shifokorga borishning SABABI → BECAUSE.
'and' bo'lsa mantiqiy bog'lanish yo'qoladi.

items.textEn: 2  She finished work and / but went home.
items.whyUz:
Ishni tugatib, uyga ketish — TABIIY ketma-ketlik,
qarama-qarshilik YO'Q → AND.
'but' bo'lsa g'alati bo'lardi.

items.textEn: 3  I love bacon and eggs until / but my sister doesn't.
items.whyUz:
'I love' ↔ 'my sister DOESN'T' — QARAMA-QARShILIK → BUT.
'until' vaqt bildiradi — bu yerda mantiqsiz.
'doesn't' = doesn't love (fe'l takrorlanmagan).

items.textEn: 4  I learned to play the guitar when / and I was nine.
items.hintUz: 'I was nine' — bu QACHON bo'lganini aytadi
items.whyUz:
'I was nine' — harakat QAChON sodir bo'lganini ko'rsatadi → WHEN.
43-betdagi nazariyada shu misol bor edi
('when I was five').

items.textEn: 5  We didn't go to the cinema until / but my mother came home.
items.whyUz:
Onasi kelGUNICHA kinoteatrga bormadilar → UNTIL.
Ma'nosi: onasi kelgach bordilar.
'until' inkor bilan juda tez-tez ishlatiladi.

items.textEn: 6  I went home early yesterday and / because I was very tired.
items.whyUz:
'I was very tired' — erta uyga ketishning SABABI → BECAUSE.
1-band bilan bir xil mantiq.

items.textEn: 7  I made a cake when / until I got home.
items.whyUz:
'I got home' — tort pishirish QAChON boshlanganini
ko'rsatadi → WHEN.
'until' bo'lsa ma'nosi 'uyga kelgunicha tort pishirdim' —
mantiqsiz.

items.textEn: 8  I washed the car but / and I didn't tidy my room.
items.whyUz:
'I washed' (tasdiq) ↔ 'I DIDN'T tidy' (inkor) —
QARAMA-QARShILIK → BUT.
Coursebook 72-betdagi 10-mashqda ham shu qolip edi:
'I made a cake yesterday BUT I didn't cook dinner.'

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in a, an or the where necessary.
exercises.instructionUz: Kerak bo'lgan joyga a, an yoki the ni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
DIQQAT — 'WHERE NECESSARY':
  Ba'zi bo'shliqlarga HECH NARSA qo'yilmaydi (—).

QOIDALAR (42-betdan):

  THE QO'YILMAYDI:
     shahar nomlari       Athens, New York
     mamlakat nomlari     Greece, America
     odam ismlari         Jerry
     ovqat nomlari        dinner

  THE QO'YILADI:
     oila nomlari         the Browns
     mashhur yodgorliklar the Statue of Liberty
     ilgari aytilgan yoki ma'lum narsa  the park, the cinema

  A/AN QO'YILADI:
     birinchi marta aytilgan sanaladigan ot
        a brother, a picnic, a cake, an apple
     kasb                 a famous composer

  A yoki AN — TOVUShGA qaraladi:
     undosh tovush → A   (a brother, a picnic, a cake)
     unli tovush   → AN  (an excellent, an awful, an apple)

items.textEn: 1  ............ Athens is the capital of ............ Greece.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'Athens' — ShAHAR nomi (atoqli ot) → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
Afina — Gretsiya poytaxti.

'Greece' — MAMLAKAT nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
DIQQAT: 'THE capital' da 'the' allaqachon yozilgan —
chunki poytaxt YAGONA.

items.textEn: 2  I have ............ brother and two sisters.
items.whyUz:
Birinchi marta aytilyapti, BIRLIK sanaladigan ot → A.
'brother' — 'b' undosh tovush → A ('an' EMAS).
DIQQAT: 'two sisters' oldidan artikl KERAK EMAS —
son allaqachon bor.

'excellent' — 'e' UNLI tovush → AN.
DIQQAT: artikl SIFATdan oldin turadi, otdan emas:
  AN excellent restaurant  ✓
  excellent A restaurant   ✗

'the Browns' — OILA nomi → THE SHART + ko'plik -S.
42-betdagi qoidada shu misol bor edi.
Ma'nosi: Braunlar oilasi.

'America' — MAMLAKAT nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
DIQQAT: 'the USA' esa THE bilan (ko'plik shaklda).

items.textEn: 5  We had ............ picnic in ............ park yesterday.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'picnic' birinchi marta aytilyapti → A.
'p' undosh tovush → A.
'have a picnic' = piknik qilmoq.

'THE park' — gaplashuvchilarga MA'LUM bo'lgan bog'
(o'z shaharlaridagi bog') → THE.
Bu 'birinchi marta / ilgari ma'lum' qoidasining
ikkinchi turi: kontekstdan ma'lum bo'lgan narsa.

'dinner' — OVQAT nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.
42-betdagi qoida: 'names of meals: dinner, breakfast'.

'cake' birinchi marta aytilyapti, sanaladigan → A.
'c' undosh tovush → A.
DIQQAT: bir gapda ikki xil qoida —
'dinner' (ovqat nomi, artiklsiz) va 'a cake' (sanaladigan ot).

items.textEn: 7  I saw ............ awful film at ............ cinema last night.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'awful' — 'a' UNLI tovush → AN.
'awful' = dahshatli, juda yomon.

'THE cinema' — ma'lum, mahalliy kinoteatr → THE.
Shunga o'xshash: go to the cinema, go to the theatre.

items.textEn: 8  ............ Statue of Liberty is in ............ New York.  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'THE Statue of Liberty' — YAGONA, mashhur yodgorlik → THE.
Shunga o'xshash: the Eiffel Tower, the Great Wall.
'a statue' = haykal;  'liberty' = ozodlik.
'New York' — ShAHAR nomi → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 9  Did you get ............ apple for ............ Jerry?  [1-bo'shliq]
items.whyUz:
'apple' — 'a' UNLI tovush → AN.
42-betdagi Pronunciation qutisida ham 'the apple' misoli bor.
'Jerry' — ATOQLI OT (ism) → artikl QO'YILMAYDI.

items.textEn: 10  Vivaldi was ............ famous composer and violinist.
items.whyUz:
KASB → artikl SHART.
'famous' — 'f' undosh tovush → A.
DIQQAT: ikki kasb ('composer and violinist') bo'lsa ham
artikl BIR MARTA yoziladi.
Vivaldi — Coursebook 73 va 75-betlarda ham bor edi.

wordFormation.introUz: 46-bet — uch zamon so'roq shakllari, bog'lovchilar, artikllar.

items.derivedUz: went to the doctor because she was ill
I love it but my sister doesn't

patterns.formula: She IS PLAYING ... (hozir)   ↔   She usually PLAYS ... (odat).
patterns.exampleEn: She is playing computer games. She usually plays computer games in her free time.
patterns.exampleUz: U hozir kompyuter o'yini o'ynayapti. U odatda bo'sh vaqtida kompyuter o'yini o'ynaydi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir suhbatda ikki zamon —
chunki ular BOSHQA-BOSHQA narsani aytadi.

patterns.formula: I BOUGHT it at ... (o'sha safar)   ↔   I always BUY ... (odat).
patterns.exampleEn: I bought it at Harrods. I always buy my clothes there.
patterns.exampleUz: Uni Harrodsdan sotib oldim. Kiyimlarimni doim o'sha yerdan sotib olaman.
patterns.explanationUz: 'always' → present simple;  aniq voqea → past simple.

patterns.exampleEn: Sally went to the doctor because she was ill. I washed the car but I didn't tidy my room.
patterns.exampleUz: Salli shifokorga bordi, chunki kasal edi. Mashinani yuvdim, lekin xonamni yig'ishtirmadim.
patterns.explanationUz: BECAUSE — sabab;  BUT — tasdiq ↔ inkor qarama-qarshiligi.

patterns.formula: 1-gap + UNTIL + vaqt gapi.   /   1-gap + WHEN + vaqt gapi.
patterns.exampleEn: We didn't go to the cinema until my mother came home. I made a cake when I got home.
patterns.exampleUz: Onam uyga kelgunicha kinoteatrga bormadik. Uyga kelgach tort pishirdim.

patterns.formula: THE + oila nomi + are from + mamlakat.
patterns.explanationUz:
Oila nomi → THE + ko'plik -S.
Mamlakat nomi → artiklsiz.

patterns.exampleEn: Vivaldi was a famous composer and violinist.
patterns.exampleUz: Vivaldi mashhur bastakor va skripkachi edi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kasb oldidan artikl SHART.
Ikki kasb bo'lsa ham artikl BIR MARTA.
